sourceEntry: 2026-11-01 — Shipment costing: line landed cost fix, HR assessments, Copilot composer
releaseSummary: Shipment costing: per-line **Landed/unit** and the **Sell** price and markup beside it were overstated on non-BBD shipments (about double for USD) because the exchange rate was applied twice. Line landed costs now add up to the shipment's landed total. Saved shipment totals are unchanged; the line figures on screen and in the Lines CSV export change.
Shipment lines can be linked to an Innovations order; the order's lens total then fixes the sell price and markup is derived.
The binder cover now shows the supplier name, VAT, total landed cost, the multiplier and each line's landed cost, and continues onto further pages when a shipment is long.
HR: employee assessments, departments and manager reporting lines.
